title: COURSE-SKILL ATLAS: A NATIONAL LONGITUDINAL DATASET OF SKILLS TAUGHT IN U.S. HIGHER EDUCATION CURRICULA
reasoning: The paper includes 'Theology' and 'Religion' as two of the 62 analyzed fields of study (FOS) in its dataset. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious tenets, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems themselves; rather, it uses NLP to map the syllabi of those majors to general workplace skills and activities (DWAs) defined by the U.S. Department of Labor.
